verses.en: A copy of an epistle, which Jeremy sent to them which were to be led captives into Babel by the king of the Babylonians, to certify them, as it was commanded him of YAHUAH.
verses.am: A copy of an epistle, which Jeremy sent to them which were to be led captives into Babylon by the king of the Babylonians, to certify them, as it was commanded him of God.

verses.en: Because of the sins which you have committed before YAHUAH, you shall be led away captives to Babel by Nabuchodonosor king of the Babylonians.
verses.am: Because of the sins which you⌃ have committed before God, you⌃ shall be led away captives to Babylon by Nabuchodonosor king of the Babylonians.

verses.en: So when you come to Babel, you shall remain there many years, and for a long season, even for seven generations: and after that I will bring you out peaceably from thence.
verses.am: So when you⌃ come to Babylon, you⌃ shall remain there many years, and for a long season, even for seven generations: and after that I will bring you out peaceably from thence.

verses.en: But now shall you see in Babel elohim of silver, and of gold, and of wood, borne upon shoulders, which cause the nations to fear.
verses.am: But now shall you⌃ see in Babylon gods of silver, and of gold, and of wood, borne upon shoulders, which cause the nations to fear.

verses.en: Beware therefore that you in no wise become like to the strangers, neither let fear take hold upon you because of them, when you see the multitude before them and behind them, worshipping them.
verses.am: Beware therefore that you⌃ in no wise become like to the strangers, neither let fear take hold upon you because of them, when you⌃ see the multitude before them and behind them, worshipping them.

verses.en: But say you in your hearts, O YAHUAH, we must worship you.
verses.am: But say you⌃ in your hearts, O Lord, we must worship you.

verses.en: For my angel is with you, Or, and he careth and I myself do care for your Or, lives souls.
verses.am: For my angel is with you, Or, and he careth and I myself do care for your Or, lives souls.

verses.en: For their tongue is polished by the workman, and they themselves are overlaid with gold and with silver; yet are they but false, and can’t speak.
verses.am: For their tongue is polished by the workman, and they themselves are overlaid with gold and with silver; yet are they but false, and can’t speak.

verses.en: And taking gold, as it were for a virgin that loves to go gay, they make crowns for the heads of their elohim:
verses.am: And taking gold, as it were for a virgin that loves to go gay, they make crowns for the heads of their gods:

verses.en: and sometimes also the priests convey from their elohim gold and silver, and bestow it upon themselves;
verses.am: and sometimes also the priests convey from their gods gold and silver, and bestow it upon themselves;

verses.en: and will even give thereof to the common harlots: and they deck them as men with garments, even the elohim of silver, and elohim of gold, and of wood.
verses.am: and will even give thereof to the common harlots: and they deck them as men with garments, even the gods of silver, and gods of gold, and of wood.

verses.en: Yet can’t these elohim save themselves from rust and moths, though they be covered with purple raiment.
verses.am: Yet can’t these gods save themselves from rust and moths, though they be covered with purple raiment.

verses.en: They wipe their faces because of the dust of the temple, which is thick upon them.
verses.am: They wipe their faces because of the dust of the temple, which is thick upon them.

verses.en: And he that can’t put to death one that offends against him holds a sceptre, as though he were judge of a country.
verses.am: And he that can’t put to death one that offends against him holds a sceptre, as though he were judge of a country.

verses.en: He has also a dagger in his right hand, and an axe: but can’t deliver himself from war and robbers.
verses.am: He has also a dagger in his right hand, and an axe: but can’t deliver himself from war and robbers.

verses.en: Whereby they are known not to be elohim: therefore fear them not.
verses.am: Whereby they are known not to be gods: therefore fear them not.

verses.en: For like as a vessel that a man uses is nothing worth when it is broken; even so it is with their elohim: when they be set up in the temples their eyes be full of dust through the feet of those who come in.
verses.am: For like as a vessel that a man uses is nothing worth when it is broken; even so it is with their gods: when they be set up in the temples their eyes be full of dust through the feet of those who come in.

verses.en: And as the courts are made sure on every side upon him that offends the king, as being committed to suffer death; even so the priests make fast their temples with doors, with locks, and bars, lest they be carried off by robbers.
verses.am: And as the courts are made sure on every side upon him that offends the king, as being committed to suffer death; even so the priests make fast their temples with doors, with locks, and bars, lest they be carried off by robbers.

verses.en: They light them candles, yes, more than for themselves, whereof they can’t see one.
verses.am: They light them candles, yes, more than for themselves, whereof they can’t see one.

verses.en: They are as one of the beams of the temple; and men say their hearts are eaten out, when things creeping out of the earth devour both them and their raiment: they feel it not
verses.am: They are as one of the beams of the temple; and men say their hearts are eaten out, when things creeping out of the earth devour both them and their raiment: they feel it not

verses.en: when their faces are blacked through the smoke that comes out of the temple:
verses.am: when their faces are blacked through the smoke that comes out of the temple:

verses.en: upon their bodies and heads alight bats, swallows, and birds; and in like manner the cats also.
verses.am: upon their bodies and heads alight bats, swallows, and birds; and in like manner the cats also.

verses.en: Whereby you may know that they are no elohim: therefore fear them not.
verses.am: Whereby you⌃ may know that they are no gods: therefore fear them not.

verses.en: Notwithstanding the gold wherewith they are beset to make them beautiful, except one wipe off the rust, they will not shine: for not even when they were molten did they feel it.
verses.am: Notwithstanding the gold wherewith they are beset to make them beautiful, except one wipe off the rust, they will not shine: for not even when they were molten did they feel it.

verses.en: Things wherein there is no breath are bought at any cost.
verses.am: Things wherein there is no breath are bought at any cost.

verses.en: Having no feet, they are borne upon shoulders, whereby they declare to men that they be nothing worth.
verses.am: Having no feet, they are borne upon shoulders, whereby they declare to men that they be nothing worth.

verses.en: They also that serve them are ashamed: for if they fall to the ground at any time, they can’t rise up again of themselves: neither, if they be set awry, can they make themselves straight: but the offerings are set before them, as if they were dead men.
verses.am: They also that serve them are ashamed: for if they fall to the ground at any time, they can’t rise up again of themselves: neither, if they be set awry, can they make themselves straight: but the offerings are set before them, as if they were dead men.

verses.en: And the things that are sacrificed to them, their priests sell and spend; and in like manner their wives also lay up part thereof in salt; but to the poor and to the impotent will they give nothing thereof.
verses.am: And the things that are sacrificed to them, their priests sell and spend; and in like manner their wives also lay up part thereof in salt; but to the poor and to the impotent will they give nothing thereof.

verses.en: The menstruous woman and the woman in childbed touch their sacrifices: knowing therefore by these things that they are no elohim, fear them not.
verses.am: The menstruous woman and the woman in childbed touch their sacrifices: knowing therefore by these things that they are no gods, fear them not.

verses.en: For how can they be called elohim? because women set meat before the elohim of silver, gold, and wood.
verses.am: For how can they be called gods? because women set meat before the gods of silver, gold, and wood.

verses.en: And in their temples the priests Or, bear the litter sit on seats, having their clothes tore, and their heads and beards shaven, and nothing upon their heads.
verses.am: And in their temples the priests Or, bear the litter sit on seats, having their clothes tore, and their heads and beards shaven, and nothing upon their heads.

verses.en: They roar and cry before their elohim, as men do at the feast when one is dead.
verses.am: They roar and cry before their gods, as men do at the feast when one is dead.

verses.en: The priests also take off garments from them, and clothe their wives and children withal.
verses.am: The priests also take off garments from them, and clothe their wives and children withal.

verses.en: Whether it be evil that one does to them, or good, they are not able to recompense it: they can neither set up a king, nor put him down.
verses.am: Whether it be evil that one does to them, or good, they are not able to recompense it: they can neither set up a king, nor put him down.

verses.en: In like manner, they can neither give riches nor money: though a man make a vow to them, and keep it not, they will never exact it.
verses.am: In like manner, they can neither give riches nor money: though a man make a vow to them, and keep it not, they will never exact it.

verses.en: They can save no man from death, neither deliver the weak from the mighty.
verses.am: They can save no man from death, neither deliver the weak from the mighty.

verses.en: They can’t restore a blind man to his sight, nor deliver any that is in distress.
verses.am: They can’t restore a blind man to his sight, nor deliver any that is in distress.

verses.en: They can show no mercy to the widow, nor do good to the fatherless.
verses.am: They can show no mercy to the widow, nor do good to the fatherless.

verses.en: They are like the stones that be hewn out of the mountain, these elohim of wood, and that are overlaid with gold and with silver: those who minister to them shall be confounded.
verses.am: They are like the stones that be hewn out of the mountain, these gods of wood, and that are overlaid with gold and with silver: those who minister to them shall be confounded.

verses.en: How should a man then think or say that they are elohim, when even the Chaldeans themselves dishonor them?
verses.am: How should a man then think or say that they are gods, when even the Chaldeans themselves dishonor them?

verses.en: Who if they shall see one dumb that can’t speak, they bring him, and entreat him to call upon Bel, as though he were able to understand.
verses.am: Who if they shall see one dumb that can’t speak, they bring him, and entreat him to call upon Bel, as though he were able to understand.

verses.en: Yet they can’t perceive this themselves, and forsake them: for they have no understanding.
verses.am: Yet they can’t perceive this themselves, and forsake them: for they have no understanding.

verses.en: The women also with cords about them sit in the ways, burning bran for incense: but if any of them, drawn by some that passes by, lie with him, she reproaches her fellow, that she was not thought as worthy as herself, nor her cord broken.
verses.am: The women also with cords about them sit in the ways, burning bran for incense: but if any of them, drawn by some that passes by, lie with him, she reproaches her fellow, that she was not thought as worthy as herself, nor her cord broken.

verses.en: Whatsoever is done among them is false: how should a man then think or say that they are elohim?
verses.am: Whatsoever is done among them is false: how should a man then think or say that they are gods?

verses.en: They are fashioned by carpenters and goldsmiths: they can be nothing else than the workmen will have them to be.
verses.am: They are fashioned by carpenters and goldsmiths: they can be nothing else than the workmen will have them to be.

verses.en: And they themselves that fashioned them can never continue long; how then should the things that are fashioned by them?
verses.am: And they themselves that fashioned them can never continue long; how then should the things that are fashioned by them?

verses.en: For they have left lies and reproaches to those who come after.
verses.am: For they have left lies and reproaches to those who come after.

verses.en: For when there comes any war or plague upon them, the priests consult with themselves, where they may be hidden with them.
verses.am: For when there comes any war or plague upon them, the priests consult with themselves, where they may be hidden with them.

verses.en: How then can’t men understand that they be no elohim, which can neither save themselves from war, nor from plague?
verses.am: How then can’t men understand that they be no gods, which can neither save themselves from war, nor from plague?

verses.en: For seeing they be but of wood, and overlaid with gold and with silver, it shall be known hereafter that they are false:
verses.am: For seeing they be but of wood, and overlaid with gold and with silver, it shall be known hereafter that they are false:

verses.en: and it shall be manifest to all nations and kings that they are no elohim, but the works of men’s hands, and that there is no work of YAHUAH in them.
verses.am: and it shall be manifest to all nations and kings that they are no gods, but the works of men’s hands, and that there is no work of God in them.

verses.en: Who then may not know that they are no elohim?
verses.am: Who then may not know that they are no gods?

verses.en: For neither can they set up a king in a land, nor give rain to men.
verses.am: For neither can they set up a king in a land, nor give rain to men.

verses.en: Neither can they judge their own cause, nor Another reading is, deliver him that is wronged. redress a wrong, being unable: for they are as crows between heaven and earth.
verses.am: Neither can they judge their own cause, nor Another reading is, deliver him that is wronged. redress a wrong, being unable: for they are as crows between heaven and earth.

verses.en: For even when fire falls upon the house of elohim of wood, or overlaid with gold or with silver, their priests will flee away, and escape, but they themselves shall be burned asunder like beams.
verses.am: For even when fire falls upon the house of gods of wood, or overlaid with gold or with silver, their priests will flee away, and escape, but they themselves shall be burned asunder like beams.

verses.en: Moreover they can’t withstand any king or enemies: how should a man then allow or think that they be elohim?
verses.am: Moreover they can’t withstand any king or enemies: how should a man then allow or think that they be gods?

verses.en: Neither are those elohim of wood, and overlaid with silver or with gold, able to escape either from thieves or robbers.
verses.am: Neither are those gods of wood, and overlaid with silver or with gold, able to escape either from thieves or robbers.

verses.en: Whose gold, and silver, and garments wherewith they are clothed, they that are strong will take from them, and go away withal: neither shall they be able to help themselves.
verses.am: Whose gold, and silver, and garments wherewith they are clothed, they that are strong will take from them, and go away withal: neither shall they be able to help themselves.

verses.en: Therefore it is better to be a king that shows his manhood, or else a vessel in a house profitable for that whereof the owner shall have need, than such false elohim; or even a door in a house, to keep the things safe that be therein, than such false elohim; or a pillar of wood in a palace, than such false elohim.
verses.am: Therefore it is better to be a king that shows his manhood, or else a vessel in a house profitable for that whereof the owner shall have need, than such false gods; or even a door in a house, to keep the things safe that be therein, than such false gods; or a pillar of wood in a palace, than such false gods.

verses.en: For sun, and moon, and stars, being bright and sent to do their offices, are obedient.
verses.am: For sun, and moon, and stars, being bright and sent to do their offices, are obedient.

verses.en: Likewise also the lightning when it glittereth is fair to see; and after the same manner the wind also blows in every country.
verses.am: Likewise also the lightning when it glittereth is fair to see; and after the same manner the wind also blows in every country.

verses.en: And when YAHUAH commands the clouds to go over the whole world, they do as they are bidden.
verses.am: And when God commands the clouds to go over the whole world, they do as they are bidden.

verses.en: And the fire sent from above to consume mountains and woods does as it is commanded: but these are to be likened to them neither in show nor power.
verses.am: And the fire sent from above to consume mountains and woods does as it is commanded: but these are to be likened to them neither in show nor power.

verses.en: Wherefore a man should neither think nor say that they are elohim, seeing they are able neither to judge causes, nor to do good to men.
verses.am: Wherefore a man should neither think nor say that they are gods, seeing they are able neither to judge causes, nor to do good to men.

verses.en: Knowing therefore that they are no elohim, fear them not.
verses.am: Knowing therefore that they are no gods, fear them not.

verses.en: For they can neither curse nor bless kings:
verses.am: For they can neither curse nor bless kings:

verses.en: neither can they show signs in the heavens among the nations, nor shine as the sun, nor give light as the moon.
verses.am: neither can they show signs in the heavens among the nations, nor shine as the sun, nor give light as the moon.

verses.en: The beasts are better than they: for they can get under a covert, and help themselves.
verses.am: The beasts are better than they: for they can get under a covert, and help themselves.

verses.en: In no wise then is it manifest to us that they are elohim: therefore fear them not.
verses.am: In no wise then is it manifest to us that they are gods: therefore fear them not.

verses.en: For as a scarecrow in a garden of cucumbers that keeps nothing, so are their elohim of wood, and overlaid with gold and with silver.
verses.am: For as a scarecrow in a garden of cucumbers that keeps nothing, so are their gods of wood, and overlaid with gold and with silver.

verses.en: Likewise also their elohim of wood, and overlaid with gold and with silver, are like to a white thorn in an orchard, that every bird sits upon; as also to a dead body, that is cast forth into the dark.
verses.am: Likewise also their gods of wood, and overlaid with gold and with silver, are like to a white thorn in an orchard, that every bird sits upon; as also to a dead body, that is cast forth into the dark.

verses.en: And you shall know them to be no elohim by the Gr. purple and brightness. bright purple that rots upon them: And they themselves afterward shall be consumed, and shall be a reproach in the country.
verses.am: And you⌃ shall know them to be no gods by the Gr. purple and brightness. bright purple that rots upon them: And they themselves afterward shall be consumed, and shall be a reproach in the country.

verses.en: Better therefore is the just man that has none idols: for he shall be far from reproach.
verses.am: Better therefore is the just man that has none idols: for he shall be far from reproach.
